name: Stain Prep - int_window
intent: Bare wood prep: sand, fill, grain raise, conditioner (combined apply+wipe), dust wipe.
doctrine: Stain prep for int_window. Universal TSK_WIN_SAND replaces former 120/150 grit progression. TSK_WIN_CONDITIONER combines apply + wipe in one task (matches DOOR_CONDITIONER pattern). Conditioner on softwood only.
